description: Repository class for managing comments in a FastAPI application, including methods for retrieving, creating, and deleting comments, as well as converting database records to Comment domain objects.

classes.name: CommentsRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling comment-related database operations, including fetching, creating, and deleting comments, and converting database records into Comment domain objects.

methods.name: get_comment_by_id
methods.description: Fetches a comment by its ID and associated article, returning a Comment object or raising EntityDoesNotExist.

methods.name: get_comments_for_article
methods.description: Retrieves all comments for a given article, returning a list of Comment objects.

methods.name: create_comment_for_article
methods.description: Creates a new comment for an article and returns the created Comment object.

methods.name: delete_comment
methods.description: Deletes a specified comment from the database.

methods.name: _get_comment_from_db_record
methods.description: Converts a database record into a Comment domain object, fetching the author's profile.
